svg.title: Eighteen Vortices With No Exit
svg.desc: Eighteen overlapping vortices act on 12 densely sampled bands. Strength 5.7, radius 610, amplitude 540, and frequency 19.7 exceed their normal controls, folding the lamellae into a turbulent field of rose and ochre. Native toolbar flow: normal spline bristles and fourfold turbulence.
